description: Separate V4 service-constrained demand-flexibility scenario: year-continuous signed thermal service states, endogenous contracted flexibility, and fleet-mobility-constrained smart EV charging. It is not Base and is not runnable until every V4 calibration input has passed its data manifest and closure gates.

parameter_status.thermal_service: Province-year retention, signed service bounds, envelope availability, comfort-debt price and contracted power are read from auditable V4 inputs; no daily reset is allowed.
parameter_status.ev_mobility: Connected fraction, charge/discharge power, fleet energy, driving withdrawal and departure minimum SOC are required province-hour inputs; ev_hour_weight is not a proxy for any of them.
parameter_status.enablement_cost: Enablement and activation prices are explicit province-year inputs, not free flexibility or an implicit battery substitute.
parameter_status.v2g_scope: V1G is the central V4 case. V2G is retained only in the separate V4 sensitivity after the same mobility contract is calibrated.
